item.title: Conrad Spa Indianapolis named among top 100 spas in North America
item.description: Conrad Spa Indianapolis has been named one of the top 100 spas in North America for the third consecutive year, offering a variety of restorative wellness treatments and amenities such as a fitness center, steam room, and sauna.

item.title: Central Indiana spared from several more inches of snow this weekend
item.description: Indiana is largely being spared from the next round of major snow events, with only light lake-effect snow expected in the northwest corner of the state and minimal snow elsewhere, giving crews time to clear roads and improve travel conditions.

item.title: Indianapolis murder case concludes with final suspect’s conviction
item.description: Joaquin Harmon-Segura, Tyler Gibson, and Savannah Allen were all convicted in the March 2024 killing of Addam Hart, with Gibson and Harmon-Segura being found guilty of murder and Allen pleading guilty to assisting a criminal.

item.title: Sheridan football legend Larry Wright returns to coaching at different school
item.description: Larry "Bud" Wright, the winningest football coach in Indiana with 463 career victories and 9 state championships, has been hired as the new head coach at Southwood High School.

item.title: Maintaining very cold air into February, potential for warmer temperatures next week | Jan. 29, 2026
item.description: Indianapolis will experience a cold start to February with the potential for warmer temperatures and snow showers next week.

item.title: Anderson man who bribed kids with candy, raped them gets 50 years in prison
item.description: Kevin Germain Jr. was sentenced to 50 years in prison after pleading guilty to four top-level felony counts of child molesting, two mid-level felony counts of child molesting, two mid-level felony counts of sexual misconduct with a minor, and a low-level felony count of sexual misconduct with a minor.

item.title: Trump sues IRS and Treasury Department for $10 billion over tax return leaks
item.description: President Donald Trump has filed a $10 billion lawsuit against the IRS and Treasury Department for leaking his tax returns to the media in 2019 and 2020, alleging that the agencies failed to take "mandatory precautions" to prevent former IRS contractor Charles Littlejohn from leaking the information.

item.title: Indiana Senate approves stopgap funding measure for child care vouchers
item.description: The Senate approved a bill that could make millions of dollars available for Indiana's Child Care Development Fund voucher program, with the funds needing to be approved by the State Budget Committee.

item.title: Indiana Senate advances bill requiring marriage-before-children instruction
item.description: Senate Bill 88, which expands the state's definition of "good citizenship instruction" to include high school completion, full-time employment and marriage, passed the Senate with all nine no votes coming from Democrats.
